title: Convergence diagnostics
text: plot_diagnostics() arranges four checks look first - R-hat, effective sample size, divergences HMC energy diagnostic - single figure.  R-hat (top left): potential scale reduction factor, one point per parameter. Values close 1 mean chains agree ; anything 1.05 means haven’t converged distribution need iterations (model misspecified). Effective sample size ratio (top right): Neff/NN_{eff}/N, one point per parameter. Low ratios mean chain highly autocorrelated - raw draws contain less independent information count suggests. Divergences (bottom left): transitions sampler abandon numerical integrator became unstable. Even handful can bias posterior estimates region occur. Energy / E-BFMI (bottom right): marginal energy distribution (πE\pi_E) closely track energy transition distribution (πΔE\pi_{\Delta E}); systematic mismatch signals inefficient exploration.

what: What to do if something looks wrong
title: Convergence diagnostics
text: High R-hat / low ESS: run iterations (ndraws), chains (chains) R-hat information detect disagreement. Divergences: tighten priors letting sampler explore implausible, poorly-conditioned region (e.g. narrow min_kappa/ max_kappa, min_sigma_count/max_sigma_count bounds, gamma priors switch rates omega_* closer scale actually expect). persist: fall back method = "variational" fast iteration adjusting model/data, switch method = "sample" instructed final check.

title: Variational vs MCMC inference
text: lambda_n, omega_n_wt, s_driver s_epi two methods agree closely. omega_p_wt different story: ADVI’s Gaussian approximation gives longer right tail MCMC , switch rate’s posterior concentrated near boundary support - exactly kind skewed, non-Gaussian shape ADVI struggles approximate well. fit method = "variational", overstated uncertainty omega_p_wt without way notice ADVI fit alone.
